_comment: Backstop for the 30-day retention on saved generations. The app already
prunes a user's expired clips when they open it (lib/firebase/generations.ts),
but that never runs for an abandoned account — this sweeps those too.
Only the generations/ prefix is matched, so profile photos under users/
are never touched. Keep the age in sync with RETENTION_DAYS.
Apply with:  gcloud storage buckets update gs://movid-76127.firebasestorage.app --lifecycle-file=storage.lifecycle.json
(or Google Cloud console -> Cloud Storage -> the bucket -> Lifecycle -> Add a rule)
